mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and a temperature of 60 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail. Tonight, the moon is in the First Quarter phase and the International Space Station passes overhead, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city has announced that chip seal road treatments will begin on September 23, affecting areas like Cross Country Road and Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the Plan Commission has a meeting scheduled for October 5 to discuss various development projects.
It is a busy weekend in Verona. Today, check out the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival or catch live music at Bailey's Run. Tomorrow, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness.
Regarding local police activity, on September 3, a 33 year old man was arrested for an O W I offence following a vehicle crash on Shooting Star Road.
The Culver's of Verona is open today until 10:00 PM. Please note that the restaurant is currently closed for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available at this time.
